title: Louis T Mother's NDE 13223
content: My mom only speaks Spanish and is currently 79 and still mentally sharp. Last night, I went over the details with her again and she decided to share her experience. This is the story my mom had always told me growing up. At the time, she was giving birth to me on Tuesday, October 1st. She was on the operating table because they needed to perform a C-section. She said she remembers passing out. Instantly, she was having an out-of-body experience and floated over everyone. She said she could see my dad and the nurses. She was watching some commotion going on. She later learned that she had flatlined for three minutes. My dad confirmed it by freaking out that his wife just died. She then found herself on the property where she grew up in the Dominican Republic. Suddenly, a man on a large white horse came over, but he was on the other side of the small river that ran on one side of the farm. She was sitting down and recognized the man. He was an old friend of my grandfathers, who had passed away about 20 years earlier. She hadn't seen him since she was a little girl. She remembers going to his funeral when was about 6 or 7 years old. He said, 'It is not your time and you will go back to your family.' She was calm the entire time and although she didn't fully understand what was going on, she was okay with what he said. Suddenly, she woke up, back on the operating table. She was giving birth to me. Throughout my entire life, I've never been worried about dying because of her story. I feel like I've always known that we continue on, after leaving this shell. I've watched countless interviews and read stories of other NDE and my mom's story has always been similar to others; so I know we'll all be okay. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 10/01/1973 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Calmness How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. Was the same as normal everyday experiences. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The entire time. From looking down and seeing the doctors and nurses to seeing my grandpa's old friend on his horse. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same exact vision, first person point of view. My mom said it was as normal as looking at the television. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing seemed to have been normal, as usual. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Old neighbor who passed away about 20 years earlier Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Calmness Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. My mom always believed in the spirit world, and it wasn't until this happened that she spent the rest of her life knowing there was something more after we pass. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Yes It was an old neighbor, one of my grandpa's friends who had passed away about 20 years prior, who was close with our family. During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Just being told that it wasn't her time yet. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes The neighbor said that it wasn't her time yet. Indicating that there was something MORE, but it was the wrong time. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life’s difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. My mom can draw, to this day, everything she experienced, even after 51 years. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes She told my dad this story the next day and all of her siblings, 14 in all. ALL know this same story. All very devout Christians. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No suggestions. Thank hlpi5to_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: An old neighbor/old friend of her grandfather (deceased ~20 years), appeared as a man on a large white horse across a small river on the farm property where she grew up in the Dominican Republic.

environment.environment_other_detail: Property/farm where she grew up in the Dominican Republic; a small river on one side of the farm.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: C-section during childbirth; she passed out and later learned she had flatlined for three minutes.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered a deceased old neighbor/old friend of her grandfather who told her, 'It is not your time and you will go back to your family.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE over the operating table, then found herself at her childhood farm property, then interaction with deceased acquaintance, then sudden return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transition to a familiar childhood location (farm in the Dominican Republic) rather than an explicitly unearthly realm; deceased acquaintance appeared on a large white horse across a small river.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It is not your time and you will go back to your family.”
